summary.text: Killian Timoney is the Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election and a former state representative for the seat, facing incumbent Adam Moore (D).
A longtime Fayette County Public Schools teacher and administrator, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a political moderate.

paragraphs.text: Timoney was born in Ithaca, New York, and in a Ballotpedia survey said his family moved to Kentucky during his high school years and that he graduated from Lexington Catholic High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in 1997 and a master's degree in 1998 from the University of Kentucky.

He has worked as a teacher, coach and school administrator, and Ballotpedia lists a role as director of physical plant support services for Fayette County Public Schools; he said he currently serves the district in cybersecurity.
Timoney said he represented District 45 from 2021 to 2025.
Ballotpedia lists his 2021 and 2022 committee assignments as including the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations Committee and the Tourism and Outdoor Recreation Committee.
In the survey he listed stronger schools, working families, cutting taxes and reducing government waste among his priorities, and gave an education motto of "Pay the teachers and feed the kids."
